hooks.name: Ward: check before installing
hooks.description: Before any shell command, reminds the agent to check new npm packages with the Ward. Dogfoods our own MCP server during the build.

action.prompt: If this shell command installs or adds an npm package (npm install/i/add, pnpm add, yarn add), first call the necropolis-ward MCP tool check_package for each new package name. If the verdict is 'undead' or 'not-found', do not install it: tell me the cause of death and propose the certified twin or a living alternative instead. If the Ward server is not available yet, check the package's last publish date on the npm registry yourself and mention it.

hooks.name: Ward: scan manifest on change
hooks.description: Scans package.json files with the Ward CLI when the agent edits them. Enable once packages/ward-mcp ships its scan command.
